heading: Contact Fin Loom
intro: Questions, corrections, research suggestions, and considered feedback are welcome. Fin Loom is reachable by email only.
enquiries_heading: What You Can Contact Us About

enquiries.title: Editorial Questions
enquiries.text: Questions about an article, dataset, methodology, or source.

enquiries.title: Corrections
enquiries.text: If a factual statement, statistic, link, or explanation needs review, include the page URL and a short description of the issue.

enquiries.title: Research Suggestions
enquiries.text: Suggestions for financial topics, datasets, companies, technologies, and market questions worth investigating.

enquiries.title: Contributor Inquiries
enquiries.text: Writers, analysts, researchers, and subject-matter specialists may write about potential editorial contributions.

enquiries.title: Business Inquiries
enquiries.text: Sponsored posts, guest posts, licensing, syndication, and other business matters.

note: We review relevant messages as soon as practical.
